title.en: An Act Transferring the Site of the Provincial Capitol of the Province of Camarines Sur from the City of Naga to the Barrio of Palestina, Municipality of Pili in the Same Province
title.orig: An Act Transferring the Site of the Provincial Capitol of the Province of Camarines Sur from the City of Naga to the Barrio of Palestina, Municipality of Pili in the Same Province
title.vi: Đạo luật chuyển địa điểm trụ sở Tòa nhà Hành chính tỉnh của tỉnh Camarines Sur từ thành phố Naga đến thôn Palestina, huyện Pili trong cùng tỉnh
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติโอนสถานที่ตั้งของสำนักงานผู้ว่าราชการจังหวัดจังหวัดกามารีเนสซูร์จากนครนาคาไปยังบารังไกย์ปาเลสตินาอำเภอปีลีในจังหวัดเดียวกัน
title.id: Undang-Undang memindahkan lokasi gedung kantor provinsi Provinsi Camarines Sur dari Kota Naga ke Barangay Palestina, Kotamadya Pili di provinsi yang sama
title.ms: Akta memindahkan lokasi ibu pejabat kerajaan wilayah Wilayah Camarines Selatan daripada Bandar Naga ke Barangay Palestina, Perbandaran Pili dalam wilayah yang sama

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1955/ra_1336_1955.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The site of the provincial capitol of the Province of Camarines Sur is hereby transferred from the City of Naga to the barrio of Palestina, Municipality of Pili, Province of Camarines Sur.
The President of the Philippines is hereby authorized to select the new capitol site within the locality mentioned in section one hereof.
Upon approval of this Act, the capital of the Province of Camarines Sur shall be the Municipality of Pili.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 16, 1955.
